text: Coca-Cola is a trademark brand owned or licensed by The Coca-Cola Company, which groups its brands under the heading 'Trademark Coca-Cola'.
short: Coca-Cola is The Coca-Cola Company's trademark brand.

source.name: The Coca-Cola Company Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (SEC, Item 1. Business)
source.quote: We own or license and market numerous beverage brands, which we group into the following categories: Trademark Coca-Cola;
